description: This file handles the preview functionality for embed snippets, including URL validation, dynamic script loading, and theme preference handling in a web environment.

methods.name: isSafeUrlToLoadResourceFrom
methods.description: Checks if a URL is safe to load based on protocol and TLD+1 matching with allowed domains.

methods.name: getTldPlus1
methods.description: Extracts the TLD+1 from a hostname, supporting only simple TLDs.

methods.name: makePreviewPageUseSystemPreference
methods.description: Configures the page to adapt to user's system color scheme preferences.
